name: h2_molecule
title: Ground-state energy of H2 (STO-3G, 0.735 A)
description: Jordan-Wigner qubit Hamiltonian of molecular hydrogen in the STO-3G basis at the equilibrium bond length (4 spin orbitals, 2 electrons; q0 g-up, q1 g-down, q2 u-up, q3 u-down). Same Hamiltonian as qumo.algorithms.hamiltonians.h2_sto3g(4).
goal: Reach chemical accuracy (1.6 mHa) on the ideal simulator and report the noisy QPU estimate.
